llm.summary: The supplied labels separate a company-specific outcome cause from a premature-stop-noise process fault. Slight benchmark underperformance does not change the remedy class: the stated defect concerns timing and path handling, while the claimed alpha itself remains uncorroborated.
llm.root_cause: The supplied labels separate a company-specific outcome cause from a premature-stop-noise process fault. Slight benchmark underperformance does not change the remedy class: the stated defect concerns timing and path handling, while the claimed alpha itself remains uncorroborated.
llm.lesson: The company-alpha book may have found a valid thesis, but stop calibration and path-risk organs failed to accommodate the realized noise.
llm.engines_credit: Company-alpha organs receive only provisional credit; entry-timing and path-risk books are the stated laggards.

causal_chain.mechanism: A company-specific thesis reportedly drove the expected opportunity.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Absent company-specific alpha, a sector or market explanation would be required.

causal_chain.mechanism: Post-entry noise reportedly triggered premature termination.
causal_chain.counterfactual: A volatility-aware path treatment might have prevented noise from being treated as thesis failure.

causal_chain.mechanism: The entry and stop configuration may have exposed the position to avoidable early-path sensitivity.
causal_chain.counterfactual: A later confirmation entry or differently calibrated stop might have altered the terminal state.

alternate_explanations: The stop correctly identified a failed company thesis.
Technology-sector weakness, rather than idiosyncratic noise, caused the stop.
Any later recovery was driven by information unavailable at entry.

signal_hypotheses.feature: Early adverse movement relative to contemporaneous expected volatility
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compare pre-thesis-horizon drawdown with an entry-time volatility estimate and dated thesis changes.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Stops inside ordinary volatility without thesis deterioration would support a timing-specific remedy.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Stopped paths consistently exceed expected noise or coincide with thesis deterioration.
